Muan|South Korea.f: Muan produces 16% of South Korea's onions, the largest volume of any county in the country.

Yangyang|South Korea.f: Yangyang was promoted to the status of Yangju in 1221 for fighting off Mongol soldiers.

Gunsan|South Korea.f: Gunsan's port opened to international trade in 1899, and its air base was built on reclaimed mudflats starting around 1923.

Wonju|South Korea.f: During the Joseon era, Wonju served as the capital of Gangwon Province.

Sacheon|South Korea.f: Sacheon's chief fame is as the site of two naval battles in the Seven Year War of 1592 to 1598.

Ulleungdo|South Korea.f: In 512 the Silla general Kim Isabu conquered Ulleungdo by threatening islanders with wooden lions.
